title: Shell command executed through callCommand or callShell in haskell — review required
description: System.Process.callCommand and callShell run a command through the system shell. A value concatenated into the string becomes shell syntax, so a separator appends commands running with the process identity. The rule flags the call; whether the string is externally influenced is a review decision.
remediation: Use proc or callProcess with separate arguments so no shell is involved.
limitation: Lexical: matches callCommand and callShell; callProcess is out of scope and is the safer form.
